new_geometry_policy: Concept identity only; no P1 mesh or geometry reused or repaired

orientation.left: LEFT SIDE 90 degrees, muzzle left, stock right
orientation.back: REAR 180 degrees, stock butt toward camera
orientation.right: RIGHT SIDE 270 degrees, pixel-exact horizontal mirror of accepted LEFT

normalization: Native RGBA outputs only; uniform resize and transparent padding/translation. No background removal or color thresholding.
